description: This Java class 'OrderTotal' is an entity representing order total details such as shipping, tax, or other financial totals related to an order within the shopping/order management system. It maps to the 'ORDER_TOTAL' table in the database and includes fields like code, title, value, module, and references to the order it belongs to.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: Represents the total amounts related to an order, such as shipping costs or taxes, stored in the 'ORDER_TOTAL' table and linked to the corresponding order.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order total.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order total.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the order total (e.g., 'Shipping', 'Tax').

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the order total.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the descriptive text associated with the order total.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the descriptive text for the order total.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the monetary value of the order total.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the monetary value of the order total.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with the order total, possibly indicating the processing module.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module related to this order total.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order index for display or processing.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order index.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order to which this total belongs.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates this total with a specific order.

methods.name: getOrderTotalCode
methods.description: Returns the code (e.g., 'SHIPPING', 'TAX') representing the type of total.

methods.name: setOrderTotalCode
methods.description: Sets the code representing the total type.

methods.name: getOrderValueType
methods.description: Returns the enumeration value type of the order total, such as one-time or recurring.

methods.name: setOrderValueType
methods.description: Sets the value type of the order total.

methods.name: getOrderTotalType
methods.description: Returns the total type enumeration (e.g., shipping, tax).

methods.name: setOrderTotalType
methods.description: Sets the total type enumeration.
